next_step: Run 2-week POC focusing on streaming chat + chained tool calls; deliver dedicated pricing estimate and SLO config
notes: Profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation) building agentic customer assistants for onboarding and in-app automation.
Primary objective: replace brittle rule-based automations with multi-step agents that can search internal docs, call 3rd-party APIs (CRM, billing), and take actions.
Latency SLOs: target median token latency <100ms for chat streaming; 95th pct <300ms. CEO: "users notice lag on multi-step flows".
POC approach: start on Hosted API to validate correctness and streaming behavior, then price out Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation.
Tool calling concerns: worried about tool-call reliability/timeouts when agent chains include slow downstream APIs. Asked about retry/backoff patterns, idempotency helpers and non-blocking fallbacks.
Cost sensitivity: high on per-token during high concurrency; interested in batching/caching recommendations from Optimize.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, encryption at rest via KMS, audit logs for all agent actions; data residency requirement for EU customers later this year.
Quote from Product Lead (Sara): "If a tool call stalls the agent we lose conversion — need graceful degrade + local cached answers for common queries."
AE notes: Good self-serve adoption internally; PM wanted quick demo of streaming + tool-calls; SE to provide sample harness that simulates chained tool latency spikes.
Risk: legal/residency review could push to dedicated/private but budget approvals are main gating factor.
